title: Classic Rabbits
description: Retextures Rabbits to be closer to their original designs pre-26.1.
body:
Classic Rabbits is a resource pack that retextures the new Rabbit models introduced in 26.1 to be more faithful to their original designs post 1.14.

![Brown Rabbit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e6ceba0d01aa122b279188c0c5de7d6b37526a19.png)

- Supports all Rabbit variants + Baby Rabbits
- Fixes UV map issues / quirks

![Rabbit Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c41e7c29e4114c9ec7015951d5041cebd910ff15.png)
